description: Add a keyword auto-reply rule: when an inbound message matches any of the keywords, the bot replies with the given text. Good for canned FAQ-style triggers (e.g. keyword 'invoice' -> 'Download it from the billing page').

matchType.description: CONTAINS (default) = keyword appears anywhere in the message; EXACT = whole message equals the keyword.

name: set_keywords
title: Add keyword auto-reply
